query:
SELECT 
  p.id, 
  p.name, 
  p.isComposite, 
  p.avgCost,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM productCompositions WHERE parentProductId = p.id) as compositionCount
FROM products p
WHERE p.isComposite = 1
ORDER BY p.id
